Description
Platinum rates have pushed more investors and collectors to diversify their precious metals portfolios beyond silver and gold in recent years. Platinum Bars like 10 oz Credit Suisse Platinum bar made up of 10 troy ounces of .9995 fine platinum offers the investors a way to add
pure platinum
to their precious metal portfolios in a cost-effective manner.
Between the mid-2000s, companies including Credit Suisse, PAMP Suisse, and the Royal Canadian Mint entered the platinum market. Credit Suisse is known Globally as a reputable private mint and one of the world’s largest refiners of precious metals such as gold, silver, and platinum.
Design of 10 oz Credit Suisse Platinum Bar Secondary Market With Assay
The Obverse of each 10 Oz Credit Suisse Platinum Bar features the Credit Suisse emblem at the top of its design field and is followed by the weight and purity of the platinum in the coin. The Credit Suisse Assayers mark is imprinted on the bottom of the obverse side of this coin, just above the unique serial number assigned to each particular platinum bar.
The reverse of Credit Suisse 10 Oz platinum Bar display an elegant, yet simple, repeating pattern that features the Credit Suisse logo, set at 45-degree angle and featured in a repeating diagonal set.
Main Highlights of 10 oz Credit Suisse Platinum Bar Secondary Market With Assay
Contains 10 troy oz of .9995 fine platinum
Produced by the Credit Suisse
Each platinum bar comes with its own assay card for authentication.
Eligible for Precious Metal IRAs.
Features the Credit Suisse logo and branding on both sides ie obverse and reverse.
Each bar is assigned a unique serial number
